components.name: Grounding Contracts
components.purpose: Immutable request, provider-query, source, and evidence-pack contracts.

components.name: Grounding Policy
components.purpose: Normalize requests and reject invalid or over-budget caller intent before provider access.

components.name: Search Budget
components.purpose: Consume request-level search budget before every provider invocation.

components.name: Search Provider Boundary
components.purpose: Expose the SearchProvider contract and dispatch into concrete providers; Phase 2 includes a bounded SearXNG HTTP implementation.

components.name: Evidence Normalization
components.purpose: Canonicalize HTTP(S) URLs, deduplicate sources, and classify evidence fail-closed.

components.name: Grounding Engine
components.purpose: Orchestrate validation, bounded search calls, evidence normalization, and fail-closed output.

components.name: SearXNG Provider
components.purpose: Build a fixed-authority JSON search request, perform bounded non-redirecting HTTP, validate response shape, and emit SourceCandidate values.

components.name: Network Target Policy
components.purpose: Reject unsafe result URLs, resolve result-page hosts at fetch time, reject the entire DNS answer set if any address is non-public, and return only validated public IP targets.
owns: localhost and ambiguous numeric host rejection

components.name: Secure Result Fetcher
components.purpose: Fetch one admitted result page through a public-IP-pinned HTTP(S) connection, bound response handling, and extract untrusted visible text.

components.name: Lexical Retrieval
components.purpose: Turn immutable fetched text into bounded deterministic chunks and rank positive lexical matches with in-memory BM25.

components.name: Semantic Retrieval
components.purpose: Build bounded deterministic chunks, obtain role-separated dense embeddings through an injected provider, validate vectors fail-closed, and rank positive semantic matches by cosine similarity.

components.name: Hybrid Fusion
components.purpose: Combine bounded lexical and semantic ranked hits with fixed equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion while preserving immutable chunk provenance.

data_flows.meaning: untrusted caller intent is normalized and bounded
validated immutable request
consume one call before each provider invocation
provider receives normalized SearchQuery
untrusted source candidates
unique normalized HTTP(S) evidence
grounded or fail-closed result
already-budgeted SearchQuery
bounded GET /search request for JSON output
untrusted result URL before SourceCandidate construction
admitted untrusted result URL is independently revalidated at fetch time
validated public connection targets
bounded immutable text and fetch metadata
bounded untrusted extracted text enters deterministic lexical chunking
bounded immutable chunks retain source URL and deterministic chunk identity
positive BM25 matches are returned with deterministic rank and source provenance
bounded untrusted extracted text enters deterministic Phase 4 chunking before semantic embedding
one query role and bounded document-role batches are embedded through an injected provider
dense vectors are accepted only after strict count, shape, finite-value, dimension, and norm validation
positive cosine matches return immutable source-provenance chunks with deterministic rank
bounded lexical ranks contribute one fixed reciprocal-rank term per unique chunk
bounded semantic ranks contribute one fixed reciprocal-rank term per unique chunk
deduplicated immutable chunks return fused score plus lexical and semantic rank provenance

external_boundaries.name: SearXNG service
external_boundaries.contract: Operator config chooses the trusted provider endpoint. Search-result URLs and page content remain untrusted and are independently validated by the Phase 3 fetch boundary.

external_boundaries.name: GitHub-hosted runners
external_boundaries.contract: Cross-platform acceptance authority for Python 3.11-3.14 on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

external_boundaries.name: Result-page web servers
external_boundaries.contract: Untrusted network/content boundary. Phase 3 permits only standard-port HTTP(S), validates all DNS answers as public, pins transport to a validated IP, rejects redirects and compression, bounds bytes, and accepts only approved text media/charset combinations.

external_boundaries.name: Embedding provider
external_boundaries.contract: Injected Phase 5 boundary with distinct query/document roles. Core code bounds provider calls and validates every returned vector; no concrete model or inference runtime is accepted in Phase 5.
